opportunities.title: Migración de Informes Ssrs a Arquitectura Angular y .Net para Plata...
opportunities.description: Cartera de Valores (CVA) es la aplicación corporativa centralizada del grupo para la gestión, consulta y análisis de la estructura societaria, actuando como fuente maestra de información sobre sociedades, personas físicas y jurídicas, participaciones accionariales y órganos de gobierno. La solución garantiza la trazabilidad, consistencia e integridad de las operaciones que afectan a la estructura de capital y propiedad, además de integrarse con SAP R/3 para el reporte de operaciones vinculadas. Su arquitectura se basa en un frontend web desarrollado en Angular 21, una Api de negocio en .net 10 y una base de datos sql server, apoyándose en servicios corporativos como microsoft entra id, ldap/active directory, saml, ssrs y smtp. Para su funcionamiento requiere una infraestructura integrada compuesta por servicios de identidad, bases de datos, certificados, red, monitorización y procesos de integración, lo que convierte a CVA en una plataforma crítica para la gestión fiable y segura de la información societaria del grupo. Se propone seleccionar un único informe actualmente desarrollado en SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) para realizar una prueba de concepto de migración a la nueva arquitectura basada en Angular y .NET. El objetivo es validar la viabilidad técnica, el esfuerzo requerido, la experiencia de usuario y la eliminación de dependencias de SSRS, permitiendo que la funcionalidad quede completamente integrada en una solución desplegable mediante contenedores Docker. La migración incluirá el análisis del informe actual, la implementación de los servicios necesarios en la API .NET, el desarrollo de la interfaz en Angular, la validación funcional con usuarios y, en caso de ser necesario, la generación de exportaciones a PDF y/o Excel equivalentes a las actuales. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Cambio mediano

opportunities.title: Fix Upstox Trading Bot Errors
opportunities.description: I have an intraday stock-options strategy running as an algorithmic trading bot that connects to the Indian market through the Upstox API and its WebSocket stream. The core logic was built with the assistance of several AI-based coding tools, but the live feed keeps breaking: option prices arrive late or not at all, and as a result the strategy occasionally skips valid entry and exit signals. What I need now is a thorough code-level review and a solid fix, delivered as soon as possible. The scope covers every module that touches the WebSocket—authentication, connection handling, reconnection logic, data parsing, and the point where ticks feed into the signal engine. If you spot other weak links while tracing the flow, feel free to tighten them up too; reliability is the top priority. Key deliverables • Diagnose and eliminate the WebSocket issues causing missing or delayed option data • Implement resilient reconnect logic so live prices stream without interruption • Verify that all signals fire exactly when they should under real-time market conditions • Hand back clean, well-commented code plus a brief note explaining what was changed and why I will provide full repository access, current logs, and example error traces the moment we kick off. Please reply with a short outline of how you plan to approach the fix and an estimated timeline; speed matters, so workable solutions that can be tested quickly are ideal.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40787183, publicado hace 1 hora (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 12,500 - 37,500.

opportunities.title: Customer Support AI Voice Agent
opportunities.description: I need an AI-powered voice agent that can pick up routine customer support calls and immediately provide accurate answers about our products, services, opening hours, and basic policies. The goal is to let human agents focus on complex issues while the bot confidently handles the high-volume “quick question” traffic we receive every day. Your brief: design, train, and deploy the voice agent, then integrate it with our existing contact infrastructure so callers experience a natural, human-like conversation from the first ring. I will supply our knowledge-base articles, policy documents, and any audio branding you need; you turn that content into a conversational model that recognises intent, fetches the right answer, and speaks it back clearly. Key expectations • Conversational accuracy: the agent consistently understands typical caller phrasing and responds with information that matches what is in our current knowledge base. • Smooth hand-off: when a question goes beyond the scripted scope, the agent must create a concise support ticket and transfer or flag the call for a live agent without losing context. • Easy management: I should be able to update answers or add new FAQs without retraining from scratch. Once live, I’ll test with a sample of real customer queries; payment is released when the agent covers at least 90 % of those questions unaided and manages proper escalation for the rest. Let me know which frameworks (Dialogflow, Amazon Lex, Microsoft Bot Framework, etc.) you recommend and how long you need to deliver a production-ready solution.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40787123, publicado hace 1 hora (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 750 - 1,250.

Here’s what has to be done: • Bulk Pricing – configure a rule that applies a percentage discount as soon as shoppers add the required quantity to their cart. • Order-confirmation Email – rebuild the template so it shows our logo, brand colours, and a simple “thank you” note, nothing more. • Pirate Ship Automation – once a shipping label is generated, Pirate Ship must push the tracking number to WooCommerce and fire a shipping email automatically from our domain. • Catalogue Updates – add 2 brand-new products and introduce 2 additional variations to items already in the catalogue. Please include your single all-inclusive price and the exact turnaround time in your first reply; that will be considered final, with no haggling later.

opportunities.title: Quotex OTC Candle Alert Bot
opportunities.description: I need a small, always-on bot that listens to every OTC market on Quotex and counts 1-minute candles in real time. The moment it sees five consecutive candles of the same colour—five reds or five greens—it must post an alert to my dedicated Telegram channel. The Telegram message has to contain: • the exact market name (e.g., EURUSD-OTC) • the candle colour that triggered the alert • the server time at which the fifth candle closed • a snapshot image of the chart showing the five-candle sequence I am comfortable hosting the bot on my own VPS, so the deliverable can be a Python script, Node app, or similar packaged solution with clear setup instructions plus the code that pulls data from Quotex, performs the candle logic, captures the chart image, and pushes the formatted message via Telegram Bot API. Acceptance criteria • Monitors all OTC markets continuously with 99 % uptime. • Sends the correctly formatted Telegram alert less than 5 seconds after the fifth candle closes. • Chart image clearly shows the triggering candles. • Includes a README covering dependencies, API keys, and how to add more alert conditions later. That’s the whole scope—once it meets the above, the job is done.

Each pair has to meet or exceed LOD 300 (350 is ideal) and be organised by discipline so that Architectural sheets/models live in their own file and Structural sheets/models in another. Here is exactly what I’m after: • Building categories to cover: offices, schools, hospitals, hotels, industrial and institutional projects. • Native .rvt files only, for both the sheet sets and the models. • A-series sheets matched to the architectural model; S-series sheets matched to the structural model. • Geometry, views, schedules and annotations in the 3D file must align perfectly with the delivered 2D sheets—no missing elements or placeholder geometry. • Clean project browser, no unused views, families or links; models must open without unresolved references or warnings. please share your samples

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Bulk Marketing Automation
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a straightforward system that lets me send promotional WhatsApp campaigns to customers who have already opted in. My workflow is simple: I upload an Excel or CSV file with the phone numbers, choose or create a template that includes images / videos and direct product links, then launch the blast. What I need from you • A small web or desktop tool that accepts spreadsheet uploads and automatically cleans, de-duplicates, and validates the numbers. • Message composer supporting rich media (JPEG, PNG, MP4, etc.) and clickable links, with a live preview so I know exactly how the offer will appear in WhatsApp. • One-click broadcast as well as basic scheduling (date & time) and throttling so the account stays compliant with WhatsApp’s limits. • Delivery report showing sent, delivered, failed, and read metrics. • Option to reuse templates, clone campaigns, and export stats. Tech is flexible—if you prefer the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API, Gupshup, Twilio, or an open-source stack (Node.js, Python, PHP), that works for me as long as it’s stable and easy to maintain. Please keep the interface clean and self-hosted if possible; I’d rather avoid recurring SaaS fees. Acceptance criteria 1. I can import a CSV of at least 10 000 numbers without errors. 2. Media-rich messages render correctly on Android and iOS devices. 3. Dashboard confirms delivery status within minutes of sending. 4. Code, database schema, and basic installation guide are included so I can run the tool on my own server. Let me know which API or library you’d use, the expected timeline, and any questions you have about the flow.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40787056, publicado hace 2 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 1,500 - 12,500.

Let me know which API or library you’d use, the expected timeline, and any questions you have about the flow."

opportunities.title: Optimize Modular Steel Sawtooth Trusses
opportunities.description: Structural Engineer: Steel Truss Optimization We need an experienced structural engineer to optimize an existing modular steel sawtooth roof structure intended to be repeated. The primary objective is to minimize total steel material and fabrication costs while maintaining structural safety. SCOPE AND MILESTONES 1. Structural Optimization Review and optimize the existing truss geometry, spans, supports and steel profiles. Minimize steel weight and structural complexity while prioritizing economical construction. 2. Structural Verification and Refinement Calculate applicable wind, gravity and maintenance loads under Vietnamese structural standards. Verify strength, deflection, buckling and structural stability. Refine and optimize the design based on the results. 3. Manufacturing Optimization Prioritize locally available L/C/U/I/H profiles suitable for fast cutting and punching with an ironworker. Minimize welding and assembly labour. All components must be suitable for hot-dip galvanizing. Compare welded, bolted and hybrid solutions for representative structural connections to identify the most economical fabrication method. Three complete structural designs are not required. REQUIRED DELIVERABLES 1. Editable optimized 3D structural model. 2. Structural calculations and verification report. 3. Steel bill of materials with profile sizes, lengths, quantities and total weights. 4. Connection schedule with estimated bolt quantities, punched holes and weld lengths. 5. Preliminary comparison of material quantities and fabrication operations for representative welded, bolted and hybrid connections. Deliverables should be provided progressively with the relevant milestones. SOFTWARE Tekla Structural Designer, RSTAB/RFEM or equivalent professional structural engineering software. We will provide existing SolidWorks CAD models. PROJECT GOAL Obtain reliable material quantities and fabrication requirements for construction budgeting. Full construction drawings are not required at this stage. Please specify your proposed software, relevant experience, deliverables, fixed price and estimated completion time for each milestone. See attached images of my different attempts with I-beams and rectangular tubes, but the goal there is to use L/C/U/I/H profiles suitable for fast cutting and punching with an ironworker.

opportunities.title: 2-Floor House MEP Layouts
opportunities.description: I already have complete architectural floor plans, elevations, and sections for a small two-storey house and now need matching MEP drawings. The scope covers the full trio—electrical, plumbing, and air-conditioning—at a basic layout level. Here is what I’m after: • Electrical: show the position of light fixtures, switches, outlets, and the main panel on both floors. • Plumbing & drainage: indicate cold- and hot-water lines, sanitary runs, and fixture points tied back to the architectural sections. • Air-conditioning: locate indoor units, outdoor condenser, and refrigerant/condensate routes. I’m not looking for detailed sizing, load calculations, or permit notes—just clear, coordinated layouts ready for my contractor to price and rough-in. You’ll receive my CAD files (DWG) plus PDFs so you can overlay directly. The final deliverable should come back in the same formats: editable DWG and print-ready PDF sheets. Typical software such as AutoCAD, Revit, or similar is fine as long as layers remain organized and lineweights plot cleanly. I’ll review for: alignment with the provided plans, clear labeling of each service, and absence of clashes between systems. Once everything matches, we’re done.

opportunities.title: Rain-Soaked Music Video Animation
opportunities.description: I’m ready to transform my three-minute song into a fully animated story that follows a lone, stylised cartoon version of me wandering through dark-grey, rain-soaked city streets. The mood sits somewhere between melancholy and catharsis: the character battles with inner turmoil, then slowly accepts the pain rather than escaping it. Think glistening puddles reflecting muted neon, steady sheets of rain, and a limited colour palette where water is almost another character. What I need from you is the complete visual narrative—character design that clearly echoes my facial features yet stays true to an illustrative, slightly exaggerated style; scene-by-scene animation that matches the tempo and emotional shifts of the track; and creative direction on lighting, camera moves, and transitions so the whole piece feels cohesive from first frame to last. Essential deliverables: • 3-minute finished video (4K and 1080p) • Character model sheets and turnaround • Project source files (After Effects, Blender, Toon Boom, or your preferred tool) • Two rounds of revisions for timing, colour grading, and key poses If you love working with water themes, cinematic rain effects, and character-driven storytelling, let’s dive in and craft something unforgettable.

opportunities.title: Caffeine Molecule 3D Print + MOVIES + 100 Pictures.
opportunities.description: **Title: Caffeine Molecule 3D Printing + Timelapse Video + 100 Photos** ## PROJECT We are looking for an experienced FDM 3D printing specialist to print our caffeine molecular model and document the entire process for MolGod, a scientific and educational project. This is more than a printing job. We require a physical print, 100+ original high-resolution photographs, a full printing timelapse, real-time videos of support removal and finishing, an edited process video, and a technical report. References: https://molgod.org/sds-cards/caffeine-cas-58-08-2-safety-data-sheet/ https://molgod.org/molecule/58-08-2/ https://molgod.org/licenses/stl/58-08-2/ ## 1. PRINT SPECIFICATION Molecule: Caffeine, CAS 58-08-2, formula C8H10N4O2. Model: MolGod ANT HOUSE v7 · RZEKA 3. - Technology: FDM 3D printing. - Material: PLA, 1.75 mm. - Colour: ONE SOLID COLOUR throughout. - Nozzle: 0.4 mm. - Layer height: 0.2 mm. - Infill: 15%; 3 perimeters. - Model dimensions: 100 × 100 × 84.1 mm. - Base: 100 mm diameter × 20 mm high. - Minimum build plate: 110 × 110 mm. - Starting temperatures: 210°C nozzle and 60°C bed, subject to filament recommendations. - Estimated material: approximately 85 g PLA. - Estimated print time: approximately 9 h 50 min. These are reference values. Before printing, confirm the actual dimensions, slicer settings, estimated print time and material consumption. MolGod will supply the correct print files and instructions. ## 2. ORIENTATION AND SUPPORTS Print at 100% scale, with the base flat on the build plate and the QR-code side facing down. Do not resize or modify the model without written approval. Use the supplied printing instructions and enable automatic slicer-generated supports. The model has 11 integrated structural supports. These are permanent parts of the design and MUST NOT be removed. Only temporary supports generated by the slicer should be removed. Protect the thin molecular bonds, small atoms, integrated supports, base and engraved details. ## 3. PHOTOGRAPHY — MINIMUM 100 ORIGINAL PHOTOS Provide at least 100 distinct, high-resolution photographs of the real process. Deliver original full-resolution files without watermarks or artificial enlargement. RAW files are welcome. Please document: A. Preparation — at least 15 photos: Printer, filament, equipment, model in the slicer, orientation, support structures, settings and first-layer preparation. B. Printing — at least 30 photos: First layer, base formation, intermediate stages, atoms, bonds, supports, defects, interventions and completed print. C. Support removal — at least 25 photos: Tools, step-by-step removal of temporary supports, difficult areas, close-ups, damage, support marks and confirmation that all 11 integrated supports remain intact. D. Final inspection — at least 20 photos: Front, rear, side, top and three-quarter views; close-ups of the molecule, base and engraving; measured dimensions, surface quality and final presentation. Use the remaining photographs for additional technical details and problems. All 100 photographs must be distinct and useful. ## 4. TIMELAPSE AND VIDEO Record the entire printing process using a stable camera position. Also record real-time footage of: - Printer and material preparation. - Slicer settings and print setup. - Starting the print and selected intermediate stages. - Removing the print from the build plate. - Removing temporary supports, including difficult areas. - Any defects, damage or unexpected problems. - Final inspection and presentation. Support removal and finishing MUST be recorded in real time, not only as timelapse. Deliver the final timelapse, original footage and available source files, plus an edited video showing the process from preparation to the finished model. State your camera, recording resolution, video formats and expected final video length in your bid. Do not use unlicensed music or third-party media. ## 5. TECHNICAL REPORT Provide an English report in PDF and editable DOCX, including: - Printer model and slicer version. - Filament brand, material and colour. - Printing temperatures, nozzle, layer height, infill and support settings. - Estimated and actual printing time. - Material consumption where measurable. - Deviations, interruptions and manual interventions. - Defects, support-removal difficulties and damage. - Final measured dimensions and recommendations. Clearly distinguish measurements from estimates. ## 6. HONEST DOCUMENTATION Document all relevant problems, including warping, adhesion failures, weak bonds, broken atoms, difficult support removal and surface damage. Do not conceal failures, digitally repair documentary photographs or discard broken pieces before documenting them. If the print fails, document the failure, preserve damaged parts where practical and explain the likely cause. Additional paid attempts require our written approval. Honest documentation is mandatory. A perfect print is desirable but not guaranteed. ## 7. DELIVERABLES - 100+ original high-resolution photographs. - Full printing timelapse and available source files. - Original real-time footage. - Edited process video. - Technical report in PDF and DOCX. - Relevant slicer settings screenshots or exports. - Documentation of defects and failed attempts. - Organized folders containing all agreed original files. - Signed commercial rights agreement. - Physical model, if shipping is agreed in advance. ## 8. COPYRIGHT AND COMMERCIAL RIGHTS — MANDATORY The freelancer must sign a written agreement assigning to MolGod or its designated contracting entity all transferable economic copyright in the original photographs, video footage, timelapse, edited videos, graphics, captions and technical report created specifically for this project, to the extent legally permissible. MolGod requires worldwide, perpetual and, where legally available, exclusive rights to publish, reproduce, distribute, edit, adapt, translate, create derivative works from and commercially use these materials on websites, YouTube, social media, advertisements, educational resources, scientific presentations and future commercial projects, without recurring royalties or additional usage fees. The agreement must permit sublicensing and transfer of acquired rights where legally permissible. The freelancer must deliver the original files and confirm authority to grant these rights. Disclose third-party assets and licence conditions in advance. Do not use unapproved third-party material or publish the commissioned documentation without our written approval. The agreement must address moral rights to the extent legally permissible. It covers newly created documentation, not the pre-existing model or rights the freelancer does not own. The supplied model remains subject to its existing CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. The agreed price must include the required rights. ## 9. YOUR BID Please state: 1. Your printer model and relevant experience. 2. Experience with delicate molecular models. 3. Available single-colour PLA options. 4. Ability to provide 100+ original photos and full timelapse. 5. Ability to record support removal in real time. 6. Camera, resolution and video formats. 7. Ability to provide the English technical report. 8. Willingness to document defects and sign the rights agreement. 9. Total fixed price, including printing, materials, photography, filming, editing and rights. 10. Completion time and any additional costs. Please include examples of previous printing or documentation projects. ## 10. ACCEPTANCE The project is complete when MolGod receives and checks the documented print attempt, 100+ distinct original photographs, full timelapse, real-time support-removal footage, edited video, technical report, original files and signed rights agreement. If printing fails, acceptance depends on complete and honest documentation and delivery of the other agreed materials, not on a guaranteed perfect object. Missing files must be supplied before final acceptance. Please quote for the COMPLETE project, not just printing.

Use the remaining photographs for additional technical details and problems. All 100 photographs must be distinct and useful. ## 4. TIMELAPSE AND VIDEO Record the entire printing process using a stable camera position. Also record real-time footage of: - Printer and material preparation. - Slicer settings and print setup. - Starting the print and selected intermediate stages. - Removing the print from the build plate. - Removing temporary supports, including difficult areas. - Any defects, damage or unexpected problems. - Final inspection and presentation. Support removal and finishing MUST be recorded in real time, not only as timelapse. Deliver the final timelapse, original footage and available source files, plus an edited video showing the process from preparation to the finished model. State your camera, recording resolution, video formats and expected final video length in your bid. Do not use unlicensed music or third-party media. ## 5. TECHNICAL REPORT Provide an English report in PDF and editable DOCX, including: - Printer model and slicer version. - Filament brand, material and colour. - Printing temperatures, nozzle, layer height, infill and support settings. - Estimated and actual printing time. - Material consumption where measurable. - Deviations, interruptions and manual interventions. - Defects, support-removal difficulties and damage. - Final measured dimensions and recommendations. Clearly distinguish measurements from estimates. ## 6. HONEST DOCUMENTATION Document all relevant problems, including warping, adhesion failures, weak bonds, broken atoms, difficult support removal and surface damage. Do not conceal failures, digitally repair documentary photographs or discard broken pieces before documenting them. If the print fails, document the failure, preserve damaged parts where practical and explain the likely cause. Additional paid attempts require our written approval. Honest documentation is mandatory. A perfect print is desirable but not guaranteed. ## 7. DELIVERABLES - 100+ original high-resolution photographs. - Full printing timelapse and available source files. - Original real-time footage. - Edited process video. - Technical report in PDF and DOCX. - Relevant slicer settings screenshots or exports. - Documentation of defects and failed attempts. - Organized folders containing all agreed original files. - Signed commercial rights agreement. - Physical model, if shipping is agreed in advance. ## 8. COPYRIGHT AND COMMERCIAL RIGHTS — MANDATORY The freelancer must sign a written agreement assigning to MolGod or its designated contracting entity all transferable economic copyright in the original photographs, video footage, timelapse, edited videos, graphics, captions and technical report created specifically for this project, to the extent legally permissible. MolGod requires worldwide, perpetual and, where legally available, exclusive rights to publish, reproduce, distribute, edit, adapt, translate, create derivative works from and commercially use these materials on websites, YouTube, social media, advertisements, educational resources, scientific presentations and future commercial projects, without recurring royalties or additional usage fees. The agreement must permit sublicensing and transfer of acquired rights where legally permissible. The freelancer must deliver the original files and confirm authority to grant these rights. Disclose third-party assets and licence conditions in advance. Do not use unapproved third-party material or publish the commissioned documentation without our written approval. The agreement must address moral rights to the extent legally permissible. It covers newly created documentation, not the pre-existing model or rights the freelancer does not own. The supplied model remains subject to its existing CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. The agreed price must include the required rights. ## 9. YOUR BID Please state: 1. Your printer model and relevant experience. 2. Experience with delicate molecular models. 3. Available single-colour PLA options. 4. Ability to provide 100+ original photos and full timelapse. 5. Ability to record support removal in real time. 6. Camera, resolution and video formats. 7. Ability to provide the English technical report. 8. Willingness to document defects and sign the rights agreement. 9. Total fixed price, including printing, materials, photography, filming, editing and rights. 10. Completion time and any additional costs. Please include examples of previous printing or documentation projects. ## 10. ACCEPTANCE The project is complete when MolGod receives and checks the documented print attempt, 100+ distinct original photographs, full timelapse, real-time support-removal footage, edited video, technical report, original files and signed rights agreement. If printing fails, acceptance depends on complete and honest documentation and delivery of the other agreed materials, not on a guaranteed perfect object. Missing files must be supplied before final acceptance. Please quote for the COMPLETE project, not just printing."

opportunities.title: Asesor Comercial Corporativo B2B
opportunities.description: Busco un asesor comercial experimentado que pueda hacerse cargo de todo el ciclo de ventas: • Conseguir nuevos clientes • Atender y cerrar ventas con clientes interesados • Gestionar cuentas y fidelizar clientes actuales El foco será prospectar y desarrollar relaciones con pequeñas, medianas y grandes empresas. Para lograrlo, necesitarás combinar llamadas telefónicas, videollamadas, correo electrónico y reuniones presenciales según convenga a cada oportunidad. Qué espero de tu trabajo: 1. Generar un flujo constante de prospectos calificados. 2. Convertir oportunidades en ventas con un proceso claro de seguimiento. 3. Mantener y ampliar las cuentas existentes, identificando oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling. 4. Reportar semanalmente el estado del pipeline, métricas de conversión y acciones próximas. Valoro la experiencia previa en entornos B2B, un estilo de comunicación persuasivo y autonomía para organizar tu propia agenda. Si dominas CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho o similar) y tienes historial demostrable de cumplimiento de cuotas, será un plus. Indica en tu propuesta: • Resultados comerciales alcanzados en los últimos 12 meses. • Sectores o nichos donde tengas mayor red de contactos. • Herramientas de ventas que manejas. Estoy listo para empezar de inmediato y evaluaré candidaturas con base en experiencia y plan de acción.

opportunities.title: White-Hat Digital PR Link Building
opportunities.description: Project Title: White-Hat Link Building & Digital PR — Raise Ahrefs DR 19 to 25 (B2B, 3 Months) Skills to select: Link Building, SEO, Internet Marketing, Public Relations, Content Marketing Project type: Fixed Price with Milestones (one milestone per month, released after link verification) Project Description (paste as-is, plain text): We are an established B2B manufacturer of premium audio-visual and motorized home/office products, selling in India and the US. On-page and technical SEO are handled in-house. We are hiring ONLY for off-page authority building. The website will be shared with shortlisted freelancers. Current profile (Ahrefs): DR 19, approx. 1,650 referring domains. The profile is volume-heavy and quality-light. We need fewer, better domains. SCOPE OF WORK (monthly): 1. 2-4 digital PR placements (DR 40+) pitching our data/statistics pages to interiors, tech, AV and business media (India + US) 2. 3-4 editorial/guest placements (DR 30+) on home-automation, interior design, architecture or hospitality sites, with in-content links to our category pages 3. Month 1 only: 15-20 industry/trade directory listings (AV integrator, architecture, B2B export, DR 20+) 4. Outreach to our dealer/partner network for partner-page links (list provided) ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA - every link must meet ALL of these to count: • Linking domain DR 30 or higher (directories 20+) with real organic traffic visible in Ahrefs • In-content, dofollow, on an indexed page • No PBNs, no link farms, no sitewide footer/sidebar links, no casino/CBD/crypto neighborhoods • Maximum 30 percent exact-match anchors across the month's batch • Link still live and indexed 30 days after placement MONTHLY DELIVERABLE: link sheet with live URL, domain DR, linking-page traffic, target page, anchor text, acquisition method, date. We verify every row in Ahrefs before milestone release. 90-DAY KPI: 35-45 accepted referring domains; DR 19 to 23-25. PAYMENT: Fixed-price milestones, one per month, released only for links passing the criteria above. We do not pay for "DA increase" promises, link packages, or bulk lists. TO BID, YOUR PROPOSAL MUST INCLUDE: 1. Three live placements you built in the last 6 months (URL plus the client page they link to) 2. Your prospecting and outreach process (tools used) 3. Price per accepted editorial link AND a monthly retainer option 4. The word TELESCOPIC as the first word of your bid, so we know you read this Do not bid if you use PBNs, guarantee DA/DR numbers, or cannot share sample placements. Bids missing the four items above will be declined without reply.

Current profile (Ahrefs): DR 19, approx. 1,650 referring domains. The profile is volume-heavy and quality-light. We need fewer, better domains. SCOPE OF WORK (monthly): 1. 2-4 digital PR placements (DR 40+) pitching our data/statistics pages to interiors, tech, AV and business media (India + US) 2. 3-4 editorial/guest placements (DR 30+) on home-automation, interior design, architecture or hospitality sites, with in-content links to our category pages 3. Month 1 only: 15-20 industry/trade directory listings (AV integrator, architecture, B2B export, DR 20+) 4. Outreach to our dealer/partner network for partner-page links (list provided) ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA - every link must meet ALL of these to count: • Linking domain DR 30 or higher (directories 20+) with real organic traffic visible in Ahrefs • In-content, dofollow, on an indexed page • No PBNs, no link farms, no sitewide footer/sidebar links, no casino/CBD/crypto neighborhoods • Maximum 30 percent exact-match anchors across the month's batch • Link still live and indexed 30 days after placement MONTHLY DELIVERABLE: link sheet with live URL, domain DR, linking-page traffic, target page, anchor text, acquisition method, date. We verify every row in Ahrefs before milestone release. 90-DAY KPI: 35-45 accepted referring domains; DR 19 to 23-25. PAYMENT: Fixed-price milestones, one per month, released only for links passing the criteria above. We do not pay for "DA increase" promises, link packages, or bulk lists. Price per accepted editorial link AND a monthly retainer option 4. The word TELESCOPIC as the first word of your bid, so we know you read this Do not bid if you use PBNs, guarantee DA/DR numbers, or cannot share sample placements. Bids missing the four items above will be declined without reply."

opportunities.title: Wikipedia Page Corrections & Updates
opportunities.description: I need an experienced Wikipedia editor to bring my existing page fully up-to-date and factually accurate. The priority is fixing several incorrect dates, titles, and names that have crept in over time. I can supply official documents and public records for every correction, so you will have verifiable, citable sources at hand. Scope of work • Review the current article line-by-line, highlighting each date, title, or name that conflicts with the documentation I provide. • Update the text and infobox accordingly, adding precise citations that satisfy Wikipedia’s reliable-source policy. • Ensure all edits comply with neutrality, notability, COI, and other Wikipedia guidelines so the changes stick. • Where space allows, polish wording and structure for clarity without altering tone. • Submit the revised wikitext and an edit summary I can paste directly, or, if you have an established editor account in good standing, make the live edits yourself. Success criteria • Every corrected fact matches the supporting document. • References are formatted properly and link to the primary record. • No warnings, reverts, or flags within one week of publication. If you have a solid track record of successful Wikipedia contributions and understand the platform’s policies inside and out, I’d love to hear how you would approach this update and your estimated timeline.

opportunities.title: Automated Business Data Collection Script
opportunities.description: I need a browser-automation script that can visit a series of websites and reliably pull down three specific data points for every business it encounters: the company name, its full contact details (phone and email when available), and the physical address. Think of it as a targeted web scraper, but built with a headless browser so it can navigate dynamic pages, handle simple captchas or pop-ups, and respect polite delay intervals between requests. You are free to work in Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or any comparable framework, as long as the final solution runs on a recent version of Chrome or Chromium and is easy for me to schedule on a Windows machine. A clear configuration file (or well-commented constants) should let me swap in new starting URLs, adjust timeouts, and set the destination CSV or JSON path without touching core logic. Please lay out a concise project proposal that covers the approach you’ll take, any third-party libraries you expect to rely on, and how you plan to keep the runtime efficient while avoiding IP blocks. Deliverables • Fully functional script with source code • One example run producing a CSV that shows at least 50 rows of scraped data (dummy URLs are fine) • A short README explaining setup, configuration options, and how to extend the crawler to new sites Acceptance criteria • Script completes a sample crawl without manual intervention • All three data fields are captured for at least 90 % of discovered businesses • Output file opens cleanly in Excel / Google Sheets without extra escaping or encoding issues If this fits your wheelhouse, I’m looking forward to seeing your detailed plan and timeline.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "I need a browser-automation script that can visit a series of websites and reliably pull down three specific data points for every business it encounters: the company name, its full contact details (phone and email when available), and the physical address. Think of it as a targeted web scraper, but built with a headless browser so it can navigate dynamic pages, handle simple captchas or pop-ups, and respect polite delay intervals between requests. You are free to work in Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or any comparable framework, as long as the final solution runs on a recent version of Chrome or Chromium and is easy for me to schedule on a Windows machine. A clear configuration file (or well-commented constants) should let me swap in new starting URLs, adjust timeouts, and set the destination CSV or JSON path without touching core logic. Please lay out a concise project proposal that covers the approach you’ll take, any third-party libraries you expect to rely on, and how you plan to keep the runtime efficient while avoiding IP blocks. Deliverables • Fully functional script with source code • One example run producing a CSV that shows at least 50 rows of scraped data (dummy URLs are fine) • A short README explaining setup, configuration options, and how to extend the crawler to new sites Acceptance criteria • Script completes a sample crawl without manual intervention • All three data fields are captured for at least 90 % of discovered businesses • Output file opens cleanly in Excel / Google Sheets without extra escaping or encoding issues If this fits your wheelhouse, I’m looking forward to seeing your detailed plan and timeline."
requirements_list: Requisitos técnicos solicitados: JavaScript, Python, Web Scraping, JSON, Data Extraction, Selenium, Automation, API Integration, Data Collection, Data Management.
Presupuesto asignado por el demandante: EUR 250 - 750.
Propuestas recibidas hasta ahora: 158 ofertas.
Cumplir con las especificaciones exactas de la petición textual y adjuntar muestra o portafolio.

opportunities.title: USA HVAC & Plumbing Drafting
opportunities.description: I handle a steady flow of HVAC and plumbing design work for projects across the United States and I’m looking for a mechanical engineer who can step in on an ongoing basis. The core need is straightforward: produce complete, code-compliant design drawings and plans that I can issue to architects, contractors, and permitting officials without extra rework. Typical tasks will include laying out ductwork and pipe runs, selecting equipment, annotating schedules, and making sure every sheet aligns with relevant U.S. standards (IMC, IPC, ASHRAE, local amendments, etc.). I usually mark up a background or share a Revit/AutoCAD model and expect you to turn that into polished construction documents—title blocks, legends, and all. Because the workload fluctuates, I’d like someone comfortable picking up a small set one week and a full package the next, always meeting the agreed turnaround. If you have a solid portfolio of HVAC and plumbing projects and are confident working independently while staying responsive over email or Teams, let’s discuss the first assignment and see how we fit.

opportunities.title: Asterisk-Zoiper AWS Configuration
opportunities.description: Necesito que Asterisk quede funcionando en un servidor Amazon Web Services y que Zoiper en Android se registre sin problemas. El escenario es sencillo pero debe quedar completamente operativo: • Tipo de llamadas: entrantes y salientes usando números telefónicos reales. • Extensiones simultáneas: entre 1 y 5 en Zoiper para Android. • Proveedor de telefonía: ya dispongo de los números, pero aún no cuento con los datos de conexión; por eso requiero tu ayuda para seleccionar o configurar correctamente el troncal (SIP o IAX) que garantice buena calidad y tarifas competitivas. Al finalizar espero: 1. Instancia AWS debidamente asegurada (puertos, firewall, NAT) con Asterisk actualizado y estable. 2. Dialplan configurado para llamadas entrantes y salientes, grabación opcional y buzón de voz básico. 3. Creación de las extensiones, credenciales y QR de aprovisionamiento para Zoiper en Android. 4. Configuración del troncal con el proveedor elegido, pruebas de llamada y registro de calidad. 5. Breve guía en español con los pasos esenciales por si necesito añadir más usuarios o cambiar números. Con todo listo, podremos marcar y recibir desde los móviles de inmediato.

opportunities.title: Custom 3D-Printed Dr. Doom Cosplay
opportunities.description: I am seeking a skilled 3D designer and fabricator to create a fully functional Doctor Doom cosplay outfit. The outfit should include full armor, a mask, gloves, boots, and a cape. It will be used for cosplay events, conventions, photoshoots, video content, and display purposes. I need it completed before December 17th. I plan to wear it to the movie premiere of Marvel's DOOMSDAY. **Ideal Skills and Experience:** - Expertise in 3D design and 3D printing - Experience in creating wearable costumes and cosplay outfits - Ability to work with different materials to achieve the desired look and functionality - Attention to detail and commitment to quality craftsmanship Please provide examples of relevant previous work in your application. I've uploaded images of general idea for customization. I've also purchased the new SWA Latverian-Saber crossover to tether a weapon of worthy proportions to outfit. Once selected for development, I have alterations in mind to crossover other fantasy sources Id love to include in the personalized DOOM fit. I would love collaboration to start development of my own 3d cosplay designing production as I've been developing a 3-D printing company and working way out to cosplay outfits. However, for this fit, I want it to be done professionally as DR DOOM is one of my ultimate favorites AND DOOMSDAY is quickly approaching. I'd love the challenge of developing this myself, and i would be remiss to loose the opportunity to go to the movie premiere of the ultimate cinematic experience of a lifetime dressed as the ultimate adversary!

opportunities.title: Cross-Platform Hospital Tycoon Game
opportunities.description: ATTENTION: PLEASE ENSURE YOU READ THE PROJECT REQUIREMENTS AND UNDERSTAND THE ASSETS ART. ANY BOT BID WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE REJECTED ------ >To be verified your ability to work: Please make a prototype demo video and send to me through chat. Thank you. --------- I want to turn the pixel-art pack at https://gainpips.itch.io/hospital-staff-patients into a full mobile hospital-management tycoon for both Android and iPhone/iPad. The art set should be used exactly as it is, so the code and UI need to respect its scale, palette, and proportions. Core gameplay revolves around three intertwined loops: players build and expand new hospital rooms, hire and schedule doctors, nurses, and other staff, then treat incoming patients while continually upgrading equipment to keep satisfaction and profits rising. Smooth drag-and-drop room placement, incremental unlocking of facilities, and clear resource dashboards are essential to make that flow satisfying on touch screens. I am happy with any well-documented engine—Unity, Godot, or a comparable cross-platform framework—as long as performance is solid on mid-range phones. Deliverables • Playable builds: Android APK + iOS TestFlight/IPA • Complete, compile-ready project source with comments • Brief setup guide so I can open, tweak, and export future versions myself Acceptance criteria will be a fully functional tutorial level that demonstrates room construction, staff hiring, and at least one diagnosis-treatment-discharge cycle while keeping the original asset visuals intact.

opportunities.title: Windows Desktop Software Development & Software License Management
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced software developer to build a private Windows desktop application that combines workflow automation with a secure software license management system. ## KEY REQUIREMENTS - Modern Windows desktop application with a user-friendly interface. - Secure license management, including 30-day validity, offline verification, activation, expiration handling, and device limits. - Backend API and database for user and license management. - Workflow automation with task monitoring, error handling, retries, and recovery. - Separate owner/admin controls and a simplified user interface. - Secure, modular, maintainable, and well-tested software. - Complete source code, documentation, and deployment instructions. # REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS - **C# / .NET Desktop Development** or an appropriate alternative. - **WPF and MVVM Architecture** - **Software Architecture and Modular Design** - **REST API / Backend Development** - **Database Design and Integration** - **Software Licensing and License Validation** - **Authentication and Application Security** - **Workflow Automation and State Management** - **Asynchronous Programming and Concurrency** - **Error Handling, Retry Logic, and Recovery** - **Unit Testing and Integration Testing** - **Git and Source Code Management** # REQUIRED EXPERIENCE - Proven experience developing and delivering Windows desktop applications. - Practical experience implementing software licensing, activation, expiration, and offline license verification. - Experience building backend APIs and integrating databases. - Experience designing reliable automation workflows with session/task management. - Strong understanding of security, failure recovery, testing, and maintainable code. - Ability to evaluate technical requirements, identify risks, and justify architectural decisions. The final deliverables must include the working software, complete source code, documentation, and deployment instructions. This project is aimed at attracting experienced developers who can deliver a reliable solution within the agreed scope.

opportunities.title: Mobile Game Visual Modding
opportunities.description: I have a completed mobile game and want to breathe new life into it through visual upgrades. The core gameplay stays the same; what I need is a developer who can dive into the existing project files, locate the pre-made functions that handle visual assets, and modify them so we can introduce sharper character models, fresh skins, and smoother animations. The project involves: • Reworking or extending the current code that drives character rendering, particle effects, and animation controllers. • Importing updated 2D/3D assets (I’ll supply source files) and wiring them into the build without breaking live gameplay. • Optimising any new textures or animation sheets for solid frame rates on both Android and iOS. Everything is already organised in Git, and the game is built with Unity, so you’ll need proven Unity experience plus comfort with C# scripting, Animator Controller tweaks, and asset-bundle management. If you’ve modded commercial APKs before or handled reverse-engineering tasks such as editing DLLs or Smali, that’s a strong bonus. Acceptance criteria • Latest test build installs and runs on mid-tier devices with equal or better performance than the current live version. • All new character skins appear in-game, selection menus update correctly, and animations trigger exactly as in the spec sheet. • No crashes, null-ref errors, or shader glitches reported over a 20-minute continuous playtest. Share a short note about similar visual modding work you’ve shipped, along with a link or build if possible, and let’s get started.

The core gameplay stays the same; what I need is a developer who can dive into the existing project files, locate the pre-made functions that handle visual assets, and modify them so we can introduce sharper character models, fresh skins, and smoother animations. The project involves: • Reworking or extending the current code that drives character rendering, particle effects, and animation controllers. • Importing updated 2D/3D assets (I’ll supply source files) and wiring them into the build without breaking live gameplay. • Optimising any new textures or animation sheets for solid frame rates on both Android and iOS. Everything is already organised in Git, and the game is built with Unity, so you’ll need proven Unity experience plus comfort with C# scripting, Animator Controller tweaks, and asset-bundle management. If you’ve modded commercial APKs before or handled reverse-engineering tasks such as editing DLLs or Smali, that’s a strong bonus. Acceptance criteria • Latest test build installs and runs on mid-tier devices with equal or better performance than the current live version. • All new character skins appear in-game, selection menus update correctly, and animations trigger exactly as in the spec sheet. • No crashes, null-ref errors, or shader glitches reported over a 20-minute continuous playtest. Share a short note about similar visual modding work you’ve shipped, along with a link or build if possible, and let’s get started."

opportunities.title: Blender/Houdini Fire & Explosion VFX
opportunities.description: I’m creating a live-action cinematic shot that calls for big, believable pyrotechnics within a $2/hour budget. The sequence features several elements: towering fireballs that roll into thick smoke plumes, controlled flames engulfing a vehicle and a portion of building façade, plus secondary details like sparks, drifting embers, and debris bursts. Real-world scale, convincing pressure, and natural dissipation are critical because the effects will sit right next to practical plates. You’re free to work in either Blender Mantaflow or Houdini Pyro/Sparse Pyro. As long as the caches and node networks are cleanly organised, parameterised, and clearly labelled, I can take it from there. Deliverables: • Editable simulation file (.blend or .hip) with all caches linked or packed • Quick playblast or OpenGL preview for timing reference The deadline is 30 days from now. Let’s collaborate to make this cinematic shot shine.

opportunities.title: Family-Friendly Supermarket Design
opportunities.description: I’m ready to commission a full concept design for a bright, family-friendly supermarket that features two signature attractions: • A fresh bakery and coffee counter that feels welcoming from the moment shoppers step inside. • A vibrant juice, smoothie, and salad bar that showcases healthy options and effortless grab-and-go service. The heart of the project is these food stations, so I need layouts, material selections, lighting ideas, and visual merchandising concepts that make them the stars of the floor. There’s also an outdoor patio connected to this zone, and I’d like the flow between indoor and outdoor seating to feel seamless and inviting. Beyond those focal points, bring the entire space together with a cohesive color palette, intuitive customer circulation, family-friendly signage, and fixtures that fit a modern grocery footprint. High-level tasks include: • Preliminary mood boards and color studies • Scaled floor plan with clear traffic flow • 3D renders (interior + patio) highlighting the bakery, coffee, juice, and salad stations • A short fixture, lighting, and materials schedule for each key zone I will provide building dimensions, equipment specs, and branding guidelines once we start. Please outline your approach, timeline, and the software you’ll use (SketchUp, Revit, AutoCAD, or comparable). Final files should be delivered in editable format along with high-resolution render images. Looking forward to seeing how you’ll turn this concept into an engaging, family-oriented shopping experience.

The heart of the project is these food stations, so I need layouts, material selections, lighting ideas, and visual merchandising concepts that make them the stars of the floor. There’s also an outdoor patio connected to this zone, and I’d like the flow between indoor and outdoor seating to feel seamless and inviting. Beyond those focal points, bring the entire space together with a cohesive color palette, intuitive customer circulation, family-friendly signage, and fixtures that fit a modern grocery footprint. High-level tasks include: • Preliminary mood boards and color studies • Scaled floor plan with clear traffic flow • 3D renders (interior + patio) highlighting the bakery, coffee, juice, and salad stations • A short fixture, lighting, and materials schedule for each key zone I will provide building dimensions, equipment specs, and branding guidelines once we start. Please outline your approach, timeline, and the software you’ll use (SketchUp, Revit, AutoCAD, or comparable). Final files should be delivered in editable format along with high-resolution render images. Looking forward to seeing how you’ll turn this concept into an engaging, family-oriented shopping experience."

opportunities.title: Diseño Flyer Promocional en Español
opportunities.description: Voy a lanzar una campaña para impulsar las ventas de mi producto y necesito un flyer impactante, completamente en español, diseñado en Photoshop. El enfoque debe ser 100 % comercial: colores y composición que llamen la atención, mensaje claro y una llamada a la acción que motive al público a comprar de inmediato. Trabajo con tamaños estándar tanto para impresión como para publicación en redes, así que el arte debe poder ajustarse fácil a ambos formatos. Prefiero un archivo PSD totalmente editable, con todas las capas bien organizadas y tipografías incrustadas o indicadas. Entregarás: • PSD editable en alta resolución • Versión lista para imprimir (PDF o JPG 300 dpi) • Versión optimizada para redes (PNG/JPG 1080 px) Al postular, envíame una propuesta detallada: explica tu enfoque creativo, tiempos estimados y, si puedes, incluye ejemplos de flyers anteriores orientados a ventas.

opportunities.title: Posicionamiento SEO Web Semana Santa
opportunities.description: Quiero mejorar la visibilidad de mi portal de noticias dedicado a la Semana Santa en toda la provincia. Mi prioridad es aparecer en los resultados de Google cuando la gente busque información sobre la Semana Santa provincial, no solo en la capital sino en cada municipio donde se celebran procesiones y actos relacionados. El sitio (Wordpress) ya publica —y seguirá publicando— principalmente: • Noticias y actualidad de hermandades y procesiones • Horarios, itinerarios y mapas de recorridos Busco una estrategia SEO integral que incluya: 1. Auditoría técnica del sitio para detectar y corregir problemas que limiten el rastreo o la velocidad. 2. Investigación de palabras clave específicas de Semana Santa, segmentadas por municipio y por tipo de búsqueda (noticias, horarios, recorrido). 3. Optimización on-page: meta-titles, descripciones, encabezados, enlazado interno y datos estructurados para eventos. 4. Plan de contenidos evergreen y de temporada que complemente mis artículos actuales y refuerce la autoridad temática. 5. Estrategia de enlaces de calidad desde portales locales, blogs cofrades y medios religiosos. 6. Reportes mensuales con métricas clave: posiciones, clics, impresiones y oportunidades de mejora. Valoraré experiencia previa posicionando medios locales o páginas sobre fiestas religiosas, así como el dominio de herramientas como Google Search Console, Ahrefs o Semrush. Mi meta es notar avances tangibles antes de la próxima Cuaresma, con tráfico creciente y presencia estable durante todo el año.

opportunities.title: Diseño integral libro de fantasía
opportunities.description: Estoy preparando el tercer volumen de una saga épica y necesito un artista que se ocupe de todo el apartado visual del libro. Los dos primeros fueron publicados por una editorial (Atlantis Ediciones) que ha quebrado y he recuperado los derechos de autor. Para los tres tomos necesito: • Portada completa (frontal, lomo y contraportada) lista para impresión y versión e-book, reflejando un estilo mágico y detallado. Relación visual entre los tres libros y una evolución oscura. • 3 Mapas de mi mundo. Los tengo hechos "de mala manera". Puedo facilitarlos para que sirvan de punto de partida. debe leerse bien tanto a página completa como en blanco y negro: Mundo completo, Un archipiélago de islas y una isla en concreto. • Pequeños diseños interiores: encabezados de capítulo, viñetas, separadores y algún motivo decorativo que mantenga la coherencia estética con la portada y el mapa. Busco ilustraciones ricas en texturas y luces, con atención al detalle y a la atmósfera fantástica. Aporto sinopsis, referencias visuales y bocetos de la geografía para facilitar el trabajo. Entregables deseados: – Arte final en alta resolución (300 dpi) en PSD/AI con capas organizadas y PDF listo para imprenta. – Archivos optimizados para Kindle/EPUB. – Versiones en escala de grises para impresión económica. Flujo propuesto: bocetos iniciales, una ronda de ajustes mayores y pulido final. Si la colaboración funciona, contaré contigo para posibles ediciones especiales y, ojalá, para el cuarto y quinto volumen. ¡Espero tu propuesta y muestras de trabajos similares!

opportunities.title: Modern Wholesale Shop Logo -- 2
opportunities.description: I need a fresh, professional logo for my wholesale store, 24/7 SUPPLIERS. The design must pop on a large outdoor shop sign, so the store name has to dominate at first glance. Please render “24/7 SUPPLIERS” in bold lettering that balances blue and orange equally, then add the tagline “WHOLESALE • MAIZE FLOUR • SUGAR • COOKING OIL • PAMPERS” beneath it. A clean, modern shopping-cart icon should sit alongside the text, visibly carrying simplified graphics of flour, sugar, oil and pampers to reinforce what we sell. Keep everything on a white background for maximum legibility from a distance. Deliverables • Three distinct logo concepts for initial review • Once I choose one, supply final assets: transparent PNG, high-res JPG, and the editable AI or PSD source file I’ll release the milestone payment after I approve the final files. Let me know your turnaround time and any questions you have so we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Stylized 3D Character Modeling
opportunities.description: I’m producing a short animated film and need a single, appealing studio-Ghibli-style character fully modeled and textured. Think stylised proportions rather than realism—something with clear shapes and personality that will read well on screen. Scope • Modelling only: I’ll take care of the rigging and animation myself, so your focus is clean geometry, good edge flow and UVs. • Topology must be deformation-ready (quads, no stray ngons) and organised into logical mesh groups (body, eyes, accessories). • Include UV-unwrapped, non-overlapping islands and texture maps (colour, roughness/spec, normal or bump—use the workflow that suits your pipeline). • Preferred delivery formats: .blend, .fbx or .ma/.mb, plus any sculpt files if you work in ZBrush. Acceptance I’ll load the mesh, do a quick test-skin and check that limbs bend without pinching. Once everything deforms nicely and textures look clean at 1080p, the job’s done. If you have questions about style references, poly budget or shading approach, let’s talk—happy to share concept art the moment we connect.

opportunities.title: 10-Minute YouTube Edit
opportunities.description: I have a bundle of mixed footage—talking-head clips, B-roll, and the occasional screen grab—waiting to be shaped into a polished, 10-minute YouTube video. The final cut needs to feel clean and professional rather than hyper-energised, so smooth pacing, tidy transitions, and restrained on-screen text are key. Here’s what I’m counting on you to handle: • Trim and reorganise the raw clips so the story flows naturally and never drags. • Add background music and light sound-effects that complement the content without overpowering it. • Drop in basic text call-outs or lower thirds where context is needed. • Apply consistent colour correction and grade so every shot matches. • Balance dialogue, music, and ambient audio so viewers aren’t riding the volume knob. You’re welcome to work in either Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, but you should already be fluent in whichever you choose. I’ll share the raw files as soon as we agree, and I’ll need the finished render (plus the project file) back within three days. When you reply, include links to past work that best demonstrates clean, professional edits—no lengthy proposals required. If your portfolio proves you can deliver this standard on a tight timeline, let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Diseño y maquetación de web corporativa en Wordpress con Elementor V4
opportunities.description: Somos QMS Calidad, una consultoría de certificación ISO en Madrid (calidad, medio ambiente, seguridad y salud en el trabajo). Queremos rehacer el diseño de nuestra web, qmscalidad.com , que hoy está en WordPress con el tema Astra y Elementor. Qué te damos hecho: El mapa de la web, con las páginas y el objetivo de cada una. Todos los textos, ya escritos y revisados. Las fotos seleccionadas. El logotipo y los colores de la casa. Qué necesitamos de ti: Una propuesta de diseño de la portada y de una página de servicio. Elegimos una y sobre esa sigues. La maquetación de unas 10 páginas en Elementor V4 (elementos atómicos, no los widgets clásicos), con estilos y colores globales, para que luego podamos cambiar los textos sin romper el diseño. Que se vea bien en el móvil y cargue rápido. Todo en borrador: la web actual sigue publicada hasta que aprobemos la nueva. Condiciones: Trabajas con un usuario de WordPress que te creamos para el proyecto. No hace falta acceso al alojamiento. No usamos Elementor Pro. Si alguna parte lo necesita de verdad, dínoslo en tu propuesta y lo valoramos. No cambies plugins ni ajustes de la web sin preguntarnos antes. Si necesitas algún plugin nuevo, que sea compatible con PHP 8.4, que es la versión en la que irá la web. Pago por hitos: propuesta de diseño, maquetación completa y correcciones finales. En tu propuesta, cuéntanos: Dos o tres webs que hayas hecho con Elementor V4 (enlaces). Cuánto tardarías y tu precio por el proyecto completo. Cuántas rondas de correcciones incluye. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Cambio mediano

opportunities.title: Editor/a Vídeo Dinámico Redes Sociales
opportunities.description: Tengo grabaciones ya filmadas y busco a alguien que domine la edición para transformarlas en piezas de unos 5 minutos, ágiles y visualmente potentes, pensadas específicamente para Instagram y TikTok. Trabajo en castellano, así que necesito que te comuniques fluidamente en español y sepas adaptar tono, ritmo y tendencia a una audiencia hispanohablante. No me importa qué software uses (Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, etc.); lo esencial es que el resultado final sea atractivo y mantenga a la audiencia enganchada. Entregables principales: • Video final optimizado para formato vertical 9:16, listo para publicar en Instagram Reels y TikTok. • Versión sin marcas de agua ni logotipos ajenos. • Archivo fuente o proyecto editable para ajustes futuros. Para evaluar compatibilidad, empezaríamos con un primer video. Si quedo satisfecho, habrá encargos regulares. Incluye en tu propuesta enlaces directos a trabajos similares o tu portfolio online. ¡Nos vemos en la bandeja de entrada!

opportunities.title: Edición creativa de vídeos sociales
opportunities.description: Grabaré piezas de unos cinco minutos hablando directamente a cámara y necesito que tú las transformes en clips capaces de captar la atención en Instagram, TikTok y otras redes. Busco un estilo rápido y enérgico: cortes ágiles, efectos llamativos y un ritmo que mantenga la vista pegada a la pantalla. Para reforzar el impacto, quiero incorporar: • Palabras destacadas y subtítulos que se muevan con la voz • Música y efectos de sonido que marquen el tempo • Transiciones fluidas y algunos apoyos visuales (imágenes o pequeños inserts) cuando el discurso lo pida Yo entregaré el metraje crudo y cualquier indicación clave sobre tono o mensaje. Tú devuelves un archivo optimizado para vertical (1080 × 1920) listo para publicar, color corregido, con audio balanceado y todos los elementos sincronizados. El primer encargo será un único vídeo; si encajamos, la idea es seguir colaborando de forma continua. Trabaja desde donde quieras. Envíame enlaces a dos o tres de tus mejores ediciones que muestren ritmo, creatividad y buena narrativa visual.

opportunities.title: Logotipo elegante para marca
opportunities.description: Necesito un logotipo elegante y profesional para una tienda / marca de productos. Quiero que combine el nombre de la marca con un símbolo o icono que refuerce la identidad visual y comunique confianza y calidad. Lo que busco • Estilo: Elegante y profesional, sin recargar detalles innecesarios. • Formato: Nombre de la marca acompañado de un símbolo o icono distintivo. • Versatilidad: El diseño debe funcionar igual de bien en etiquetas, empaques, web y redes sociales, tanto en color como en versión monocromática. • Originalidad: Solo se aceptarán propuestas 100 % originales; nada de plantillas genéricas. Entregables • Archivos vectoriales editables (AI o SVG). • Versiones en PNG y JPG a 300 dpi. • Breve guía de uso que indique tipografías y paleta de colores. Valoraré detalles como la armonía tipográfica, la legibilidad a distintos tamaños y la capacidad del icono para reconocerse incluso sin el texto. ¡Espero ver tu mejor concepto!

opportunities.title: Diseño CAD de Silla Salvaescaleras
opportunities.description: Se solicita un profesional con experiencia en ingeniería mecánica, estructural y diseño CAD para desarrollar el diseño de una silla salvaescaleras de concepto original, destinada a viviendas unifamiliares o multifamiliares, con una carga nominal objetivo de 160 kg. El diseño deberá priorizar la seguridad, ergonomía, funcionalidad, estética moderna y modularidad, permitiendo futuras modificaciones y adaptación a diferentes configuraciones de escaleras. opportunities.title: Asistente Telefónico Citas Belleza y Estética
opportunities.description: Busco un asistente remoto que atienda principalmente llamadas entrantes con el objetivo de agendar citas para mi centro de belleza y estética. Necesito una voz amable, organizada y capaz de transmitir confianza a cada cliente desde el primer “hola”. Responsabilidades clave • Responder llamadas en español con trato cercano y profesional. • Registrar nombre, servicio solicitado y datos de contacto de cada cliente. • Verificar disponibilidad y confirmar la cita en nuestro calendario online. • Enviar recordatorios breves por WhatsApp o correo cuando sea necesario. • Llevar un registro diario de llamadas atendidas y citas agendadas. Qué espero recibir de tu propuesta • Ejemplos concretos de tu trabajo anterior gestionando llamadas o agendas. • Breve descripción de las herramientas que utilizas (p. ej., Google Calendar, CRM, centralitas virtuales). • Tu disponibilidad horaria y zona horaria. Valoraré experiencia previa en recepción de spa, salones o centros estéticos, aunque no es imprescindible si demuestras habilidades telefónicas sólidas y atención al detalle. La colaboración iniciará de forma remota y puede convertirse en un acuerdo a largo plazo si encajamos bien. Espero tu propuesta.

Necesito una voz amable, organizada y capaz de transmitir confianza a cada cliente desde el primer “hola”. Responsabilidades clave • Responder llamadas en español con trato cercano y profesional. • Registrar nombre, servicio solicitado y datos de contacto de cada cliente. • Verificar disponibilidad y confirmar la cita en nuestro calendario online. • Enviar recordatorios breves por WhatsApp o correo cuando sea necesario. • Llevar un registro diario de llamadas atendidas y citas agendadas. Qué espero recibir de tu propuesta • Ejemplos concretos de tu trabajo anterior gestionando llamadas o agendas. • Breve descripción de las herramientas que utilizas (p. ej., Google Calendar, CRM, centralitas virtuales). • Tu disponibilidad horaria y zona horaria. Valoraré experiencia previa en recepción de spa, salones o centros estéticos, aunque no es imprescindible si demuestras habilidades telefónicas sólidas y atención al detalle. La colaboración iniciará de forma remota y puede convertirse en un acuerdo a largo plazo si encajamos bien. Espero tu propuesta."

proposal.body:
¡Hola Solicitante Anuncio #40783953 (Tareas en Español)! 👋 Revisé la solicitud exacta de **"Asistente Telefónico Citas Belleza y Estética"** y cumplo con los requisitos para iniciar de inmediato.

Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, secaderos de café, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.

blueprint.product_type: 🤖 Bot de Respuesta y Agendamiento en WhatsApp 24/7 (Plantilla n8n / WhatsApp)
blueprint.deliverable: Flujo ya armado que responde precios, envía catálogo PDF/fotos y agenda citas en Google Calendar/Sheets.
blueprint.target_audience: Clínicas odontológicas, centros de estética, barberías, inmobiliarias y tiendas en Instagram Colombia.
blueprint.suggested_pricing: COP $350.000 por dejarlo instalado + COP $80.000/mes opcional por mantenimiento.
blueprint.distribution_channels: Contactar por WhatsApp o Instagram DM a negocios locales que dicen 'Citas por WhatsApp' en su biografía.
